cases.name: mixed_i32
cases.independent_reason: Both Copy fields are read separately as A/C; the actual middle R payload closes once as B after the arm returns.

cases.name: mixed_wide
cases.independent_reason: A and C occupy opposite sides of the aligned resource. R checks its wide/bool fields before emitting B; any X/Y indicates a payload projection error.

cases.name: managed_header
cases.independent_reason: The middle Managed ByteBuffer is its real three-word header. The read length/data require correct ptr/len/cap offsets; cleanup frees the buffer but prints nothing.

cases.name: nested_sum
cases.independent_reason: Outer a/z are A/C; recursive selected Inner owns R and closes B. An inactive Inner branch cannot contribute a debt.

cases.name: moved_flags
cases.independent_reason: Self transfer publishes into the same lexical shell without early/double cleanup. Z precedes later L, then original shell A; moved temporary conditional drops print nothing.

cases.name: entry_error_enum
cases.independent_reason: Local L closes in source main. Only the actual error return transfers E to native entry cleanup, then exits1. The inactive error slot would contain zero-tag Owned, so accidental cleanup on success is observable as an unwanted NUL.

cases.name: opaque_app
cases.independent_reason: Private generation40 is copied exactly through two self replacements to42. finish consumes App, closes its actual State/R as A, then caller emits Z. The caller has no source field access.

cases.name: nominal_same_layout
cases.independent_reason: Two different modules deliberately use the same short Enum/resource names and physical layout. Right teardown adds32, so reusing the left resource teardown would emit B instead of b. Locals close right then left.

cases.name: nominal_different_layout
cases.independent_reason: Equal short names do not identify types or layouts. Right leaf is aligned8 with code at8; its Enum is24 bytes, while left is8. Right b precedes left A.

cases.name: context_a
cases.independent_reason: First emission in one process/session has this complete Choice/R type and its actual resource teardown binding.

cases.name: context_b
cases.independent_reason: Compile immediately after context_a in the same process/session with the same SourceUnit identity. Complete Type remains equal but the inserted function changes the real teardown FunctionId; no stale plan may call the old binding.

raw_LIR_expectations.positive: Source-derived independently VerifiedModule lowered normally must emit
raw_LIR_expectations.authority: Each mutant retains copied fingerprint but fails exact capability binding; no generated machine execution counted.

illegal_tag_check: No new source or FFI ability to manufacture an invalid Enum tag is introduced. Check actual emitted trap/unreachable CFG for out-of-range tags before payload access and final cleanup fallthrough; native corruption injection is not claimed as legal ZIL evidence.
expected_outputs_derived_from: Source evaluation order, declared payload layout/alignment, actual module resources, reverse local initialization cleanup and recursive declared field cleanup; no compiler/native output read to select these expectations.
